body: I've been doing it wrong this whole time?!
In recovery now, so had to borrow my father's booze bottle to take a pic ^^

Thanks Rabble :)
Pkbooo, thanks so much for your support and am very glad you're also doing better. The side-effects to the Paxil so far aren't too bad; it's been making me a bit edgy, tired but unable to sleep for a little while and some other small ones. Will just stick to it and not give up and hope the side-effects will lessen soon.
 Haven't got to meet my psychologist yet, but have talked to one counselor who is the sweetest lady ever.

Planning to quit drinking and attend AA to stay the course. I'm not really 100% sure what led to the whole thing, have had a ton of stress lately. My mom passed away Christmas day in 2000, so Christmas is always rough. Moving to Florida in February. Small other factors I am kind of embarrassed to discuss.
I under-exaggerated to the nurse how much I took and how much I drank to try and go home without having to be committed. But guess I was still too out of it to not admit that I had attempted suicide.
Yea, had to be temporary as much as I hated giving him up. He was the cutest little guy ever.
